Market commentary is brief and cautious: October ended weakly, tech sold off on AI-bubble fears (Nasdaq down nearly 10% in a month), retail investors are moving into money-market and short-term fixed-income funds, and the new-build housing market is slow, with developers offering cheaper mortgage rates to sell. No stock picks or buy/sell calls were made.
